title: Leaving Monk in California; Cannonball restarts his band
summary: Sam dates the wreck to about 1960 and quits Monk's band in Los Angeles after Cannonball phones him.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: When was that? About what year was that?

That was in around, gotta be in the 60's. Now, this is '60, about 1960, I guess, you know, '60, and then uhm, I was still with Thelonius when we was at, when I quit Thelonius was in California out there where the police beat him up out there.
In California, and that's when Cannonball [Adderley] called me long distance saying I'm starting the band back together.
You know, and the first job would be at the Jazz Workshop in San Francisco; so I'm already in Los Angeles.
So I say, 'hey, I'll meet you in San Francisco.'
You know, and uh, I left, I left Rouse and them dudes in the hotel in Los Angeles, and said 'I see you. You'll got this, boy, I'm through with this band. I'm through with it!'
